FDE FAQ

Before collaborating,
clarify the boundaries.

Must FDE be on-site long-term?＋

Not necessarily. We use a combination of diagnosis, co-creation, and accompaniment, arranging necessary on-site collaboration based on interviews, pilots, and go-live stages; we do not package it as long-term outsourcing.

How long until the first results are visible?＋

Usually, we complete diagnosis and planning in one to two weeks, followed by small-scale pilot validation. The specific cycle depends on data preparation and system integration complexity.

Who maintains it after the project ends?＋

We will embed processes, knowledge, and evaluation methods during delivery, which can be taken over by the enterprise team or continue to be entrusted for iteration.
